**1. Description:** Informational message flyer from UT Health San Antonio Physicians Health Informatics announcing the November 13, 2024 transition from entering non-level-of-service professional charges via Add Order to using the Charge Capture Navigator in Epic.

**2. Transcription:**

A MESSAGE FROM
Health Informatics

UT Health San Antonio Physicians

**INFORMATIONAL MESSAGE**

**Description:**
We are reaching out to inform you of an upcoming change to the way non-level of service (non-LOS) professional charges will be entered in Epic. Effective **November 13, 2024**, we will transition from entering professional charges via Add Order to using the **Charge Capture Navigator** located in "This Visit". Level of Service (LOS) charges will still be entered via the Level of Service activity within the "This Visit" tab.

**What's Changing:**

Starting on October 31st, 2024:

You will see an alert both in the Sign Orders activity and the Order itself when entering professional charge orders in Epic notifying about the transition to Charge Capture Navigator.

Sign Orders activity example:

[Screenshot: Dx Association | Edit Multiple | Estimate | Options | Per protocol: cosign required | After Visit | CORNEAL SMEAR | Performed in Clinic | "You are receiving this message because you are entering a professional charge as an order. Starting November 13th, 2024, our organization will transition to using the Charge Capture Navigator for entering professional charge orders. If you need assistance, please contact the Epic Help Desk at (210) 450-4800." | Rx HEB #620 PEARSALL, TX  830-334-3237 | SIGN ORDERS (1)]

Order expanded example:

[Screenshot: CORNEAL SMEAR — Accept | Cancel
PR Charge Workflow
You are receiving this message because you are entering a professional charge as an order.
Starting November 13th, 2024, our organization will transition to using the Charge Capture Navigator for entering professional charge orders.
If you need assistance, please contact the Epic Help Desk at (210) 450-4800.
BetterCare Charge Capture Information
Status: Normal | Standing | Future
Priority: Routine
Class: Performed in Clinic | UTM Procedure | Non-UTM Procedure
Quantity: 1 — The maximum orderable quantity for this procedure is 999
Modifiers:
Comments: + Add Comments
Additional Order Details
Next Required — Accept | Cancel]

Starting on November 13th, 2024:

- **Professional charges for procedures and supplies** will be entered exclusively through the **Charge Capture Navigator** in **"This Visit."**
- You will **no longer need to use the "Order Taskbar"** to individually enter PR Charges or Supply Orders for these encounters, streamlining workflows and enhancing accuracy.
- Specialty based charge preference lists have been linked for easy identification for your clinic.
- Personalization is available to **"star"** your frequently leveraged charges being entered for in clinic procedures and supplies to create efficiency within the workflow.
- You will begin to see automatically dropped charges being generated throughout the patient visit to identify outlier charges needing to be entered for in clinic procedures and supplies.
- Clinics leveraging Proc Doc should continue to leverage that tool as their method to drop charges for in clinic performed procedures.
- SmartSets which contain impacted professional charge orders will be updated automatically before the final transition to the Charge Capture Navigator.

**Transition Support:**
Leading up to this date, current users will see reminders about this upcoming change each time they enter professional charge orders.

**What you need to do:**
As of **November 13**, enter all professional charges using the Charge Capture Navigator only. The previous method of entering professional charges as an order will be discontinued.

**Need Help?**
If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact the **Epic Help Desk** at **(210) 450-4800**. Our team is ready to support you throughout this transition.

For ongoing updates on BetterCare initiatives, please visit our BetterCare site:

ABRIDGE FAQs
Answers to your most common questions

How do I get started?
Download Haiku (mobile/tablet) or Canto (iPad), register your device, then launch Abridge from a scheduled patient.

How do I access the Abridge tab in Epic?
Click on a patient encounter on a desktop version of Epic. Click the More icon to access More Activities. Pin the "Abridge" option.

How do I pull the Abridge note into my report?
- .HPISEC — History of Present Illness
- .RESULTSEC — Results
- .PESSEC — Physical Exam
- .APSEC — Assessment & Plan
You can also add these SmartPhrases into your existing note templates using SmartPhrase Manager.

Can I customize my notes?
Yes. Click on the Abridge Tab in Epic and use the Prompting feature to personalize note structure, content, and formatting. Your preferences can be saved for future notes.

How do specialty note templates work?
Abridge automatically assigns a specialty template based on your department. You can view or adjust your specialty settings in the Settings menu.

Can more than one provider use Abridge for the same encounter?
Only one provider can record a note for a single encounter. An attending may record a resident's presentation. Patient providers may each create their own individual notes.

Can Abridge generate a Patient Visit Summary?
Yes! Use the SmartPhrase ASPES to generate an easy-to-read, plain-language summary for patients.

Why don't I see the Abridge icon in Haiku?
You must open a patient from your schedule for the icon to appear. If it's still missing, contact the Health IT Help Desk.
